scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix apps/api" "npm start --prefix apps/web -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/web && node scripts/copy-web.mjs && npm run build --prefix apps/api
